limits: New source requires fresh exact-head hosted checks/e2e/native AMD64/ARM64/PC and all package gates.
Historical ARM64 result applies to f0d2b75, before current-main integration; it does not qualify a new SHA.
Local native replay covers Free Loader and TabMaster only; full matrix was not run locally.
Installer test covers 37 pinned fixtures over HTTP/SSH without executing official backends; it is not full e2e or the 116-plugin audit.
Native Docker cleanup is runner/source-bound; owned parent/child process cleanup is checked by PID/start-time assertions.
Retained console diagnostics and forced stops in other plugins do not establish global clean shutdown.
No live feed, notifications, Steam store, browser, managed Frame, wearer/controller or release proof.
